schema_version.description: Request contract version; must be 1 when present.

operation.description: history_sync indexes bounded first-parent Git history; import stores one DeliveryImport v2 envelope; orbit_sync imports deliveries for explicit run or task ids through public Orbit tools.

repository.description: Absolute path of the Git repository to maintain. Defaults to the caller's workspace root; never inferred from the tool cwd.

branch.description: Landing branch whose history scope is maintained.

limit.description: Per-call bound: commits for history_sync (1-1000, default 100) or runs for orbit_sync (1-100, default 25).

delivery.description: DeliveryImport v2 envelope; required for operation=import.

workspace.description: Owning Orbit workspace (ws_* id or name); required for orbit_sync.

task_ids.description: orbit_sync: tasks whose current job_run_id is examined.

run_ids.description: orbit_sync: explicit workflow run ids to import.

task_snapshots.description: orbit_sync: earlier public task snapshots used instead of live task text.
